visual_notes.text: • Location: Mumbai lane outside the closed Old Blue Gate, beside the small ground-level emergency opening. Location reference: OLD BLUE GATE.png. Camera: slightly elevated medium-close view of the ticket-marking group. Static visual: Ahana kneels at frame-left, Vihaan crouches centre and Navya kneels right. Each holds one invitation face-up towards Tez. All three tickets bear one blue volunteer mark; Tez’s right forepaw rests against the edge of Navya’s card, his left forepaw on the paving. Ahana looks eager, Vihaan surprised, Navya attentive; Tez looks concentrated. The small emergency door behind them is open enough for a child to enter; the large gate leaves remain closed. Show the completed marked-ticket state, not marks appearing. Night; the scene is outside the Gate, before entry into Entry Court. Character-sheet references (CHANDRUSH CHARACTERS): Ahana — AHANA CHARACTER SHEET.png; Vihaan — VIHAAN CHARACTER SHEET.png; Navya — NAVYA CHARACTER SHEET.png; Tez — TEZ CHARACTER SHEET.png. Use the sheets for appearance; use this still’s specified pose, expression and props. Scene-specific stripe colours: Tez’s left-shoulder stripe and the first stripe on each flank immediately behind the foreleg are pale grey; all other stripes are blue. Apply these colours to the stripe pattern in TEZ CHARACTER SHEET.png; they override its black stripe colour for this scene. visual_notes.text: • Location: Entry Court beside the empty circular Moon Bell stand on its stepped base. Location reference: ENTRY COURT.png. Camera: eye-level medium-wide view facing the Bell stand. Static visual: Tara stands to the right of the empty stand with her staff upright in her left hand and her right palm open towards the vacant hanging point. Her face is gentle but troubled. Frame the complete empty suspension ring, its rope, the stepped base and Tara; the map edge is visible at frame-right. Show only Tara. The circular Bell stand is empty; its hanging rope remains. The map is on the wall between the stand and the dark Lantern Street arch. No Moon Bell is present in Entry Court. Night; cool moonlight and low amber court lamps. Character-sheet references (CHANDRUSH CHARACTERS): Tara — TARA CHARACTER SHEET.png. Use the sheets for appearance; use this still’s specified pose, expression and props.
